title: Intravenous Immunoglobulin Market Size Worth USD 30.83 Billion by 2035, Growing at 7.49% CAGR – SNS Insider
author: Sns Insider
description: The global intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG) market is projected to grow from USD 14.98 billion in 2025 to USD 30.83 billion by 2035, at a CAGR of 7.49%. Growth is driven by expanding neurological indications, increased plasma collection capacity, and rising demand for immunoglobulin-based treatments. However, plasma supply dependency and a 100% U.S. tariff on imported IVIG products implemented in October 2025 pose significant constraints. North America leads the market, while Asia-Pacific shows the fastest growth.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Listed as a major key player in the expanding IVIG market with strong growth prospects driven by increasing demand for immunoglobulin therapies and expanding clinical applications.
Major plasma-derivative therapy producer positioned to benefit from market growth, though subject to tariff pressures on imported products.

Key player in the IVIG market with opportunities in the growing specialty pharmacy and neurological indications segments.

title: Drug Reconstitution Systems Market Trends, Shares and Growth Opportunities Worldwide 2026-2035 Featuring Profiles of Baxter, ICU Medical, B. Braun, Vetter Pharma, Nipro, SCHOTT-KAISHA
author: Researchandmarkets.Com
description: The global drug reconstitution systems market is expected to grow at a 7.0% CAGR from $5.9 billion in 2026 to $10.8 billion by 2035, driven by expanding biologic and biosimilar pipelines, increasing demand for safer drug delivery systems, and the shift toward home healthcare and self-administered therapies. Cartridges lead the market at 50% revenue share, while prefilled syringes are expected to grow faster. Asia-Pacific is projected to achieve the fastest regional growth.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Baxter is profiled as a key competitor in the growing drug reconstitution systems market, which is projected to expand at 7.0% CAGR through 2035, driven by strong demand for safer injectable delivery systems and biologics.

ICU Medical is highlighted as a major player in a market experiencing sustained growth driven by expanding biologic pipelines, increasing adoption of home healthcare, and innovation in drug delivery technologies.

SCHOTT-KAISHA is profiled as a key market player in the drug reconstitution systems sector, which is experiencing robust growth driven by demand for safer, more efficient drug delivery systems and advanced packaging solutions.

title: Why Baxter International Stock Skyrocketed by 19% This Week
author: Eric Volkman
description: Baxter International's stock surged 19% following strong second-quarter earnings that beat analyst expectations. The company reported $2.96 billion in sales (5% YoY growth) and raised full-year guidance for both revenue growth (3-4%) and adjusted EPS ($1.95-$2.15), citing strong performance across both product categories and geographic regions.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company delivered double beats on revenue ($2.96B vs. $2.8B expected) and adjusted EPS ($0.56 vs. $0.37 expected), raised full-year guidance on both top and bottom lines, demonstrated growth across all segments (U.S. +4%, international +7%), and is well-positioned in an aging population demographic trend.

title: Becton Dickinson at 13x Earnings: MedTech’s Most Mispriced Compounder
author: Gurufocus
description: Becton Dickinson (BDX) trades at a 13x forward P/E multiple, representing a significant discount to medtech peers despite strong fundamentals including 60% U.S. infusion pump market share, 90%+ recurring revenue, and record 25% adjusted operating margins. The post-spin-off transition year narrative masks an emerging pure-play MedTech company with billion-dollar growth platforms in GLP-1 drug delivery and connected care, supported by $4 billion in fresh capital deployment and ongoing margin expansion targeting 26%+ territory.
